title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV: Turtles in Time - Climactic Battle
description:
This is one of the boss fight tracks from Turtles in Time on the SNES. It is upbeat, intense and hectic.

Featured in the Custom Chuck Boss fight in the level "Sen's Fortress" in Grand Poo World 2.
